text:
Type: chunky boucle throw blanket
Use: warmth on a sofa, armchair or bed, layering; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, contemporary
Materials: looped boucle yarn with a soft woolly texture
Colors: warm taupe beige, cream flecks
Shape: folded rectangle, nubby curly loops over the whole surface, loose open weave, thick and drapey, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, soft, warm, tactile
Goes with: oatmeal or cream sofas, light oak, linen, sheepskin, white walls; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: IKEA STOCKHOLM
product.description: Mohair wool with a silky lustre.
